name: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
summary: In Theramore, Captain Garran Vimes asks you to learn who Lieutenant Paval Reethe is.

sections.title: Who Is Reethe?
sections.body: Captain Garran Vimes does not recognize Lieutenant Paval Reethe's name. So he sends you to Adjutant Tesoran in Theramore, who keeps the guard's records of its people and equipment. Vimes expects those records to reveal who Reethe is.

faq.q: Who sends you to find out about Reethe?
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes sends you to learn who Lieutenant Paval Reethe is. He does not recognize the name.

faq.q: Who keeps the Theramore guard's records?
faq.answer: Adjutant Tesoran in Theramore keeps records of the Theramore guard's people and equipment.

faq.q: What can Adjutant Tesoran tell you?
faq.answer: Vimes expects Tesoran's records to reveal who Lieutenant Paval Reethe is.
